question.text: To an evacuated vessel with movable piston under external pressure of 1 atm, 0.1 mole of He and 1.0 mole of an unknown compound (vapour pressure 0.68 atm at <math><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">ο</mi></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> ) are introduced. Considering ideal gas behaviour, the total volume (in L) of the gas at <math><msup><mrow><mn>0</mn></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">ο</mi></mrow></msup><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi></math> is close to x L at equilibrium. Calculate the value of x.

solution.text:
If external pressure is 1 atm the pressure inside the cylinder will also be equal to 1 atm.
The pressure generated by unknown compound will be fixed and equal to 0.68 atm, so the pressure generated by He will be 1–0.68=0.32 atm
Now by: V=n×R×TP
V= 0.1×0.082×273 0.32 =7 L
